variants.question: 美國某診所正在編寫乳房攝影篩檢提醒規則，查核日為 2026 年 11 月 26 日。假設一名 46 歲女性沒有乳房症狀，12 個月前例行篩檢的乳房攝影結果正常。她屬一般風險，無乳癌或高風險乳房病灶病史、無乳癌家族史、無已知致病性遺傳變異，過去也未接受胸部放射治療。診所明定按美國預防服務工作小組（USPSTF）的例行篩檢建議設定提醒。這套規則採用什麼間隔，現在是否已到下一次提醒的時間？請說明判斷依據。
variants.answer: USPSTF 建議每兩年一次。距離上次正常篩檢只有 12 個月，依這套規則，約再過 12 個月才提醒。
variants.rationale: 這名一般風險、沒有症狀的 46 歲女性屬於 USPSTF 建議例行乳房攝影的 40 至 74 歲族群。將兩年週期從前次例行篩檢起算即可確定提醒時間。

USPSTF 對 40 至 74 歲採兩年週期。因此上次篩檢後第 12 個月距提醒約還有 12 個月。

variants.question: A US clinic is writing a reminder rule for screening mammography using guidance current on November 26, 2026. In its example, an asymptomatic 46-year-old woman had a normal routine screening mammogram 12 months ago. She is at average risk. She has no personal or family history of breast cancer, no prior high-risk breast lesion, no known inherited variant that raises breast cancer risk, and no history of chest radiation. The clinic has chosen to base its reminders on the US Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF) routine screening recommendation. What interval should the rule use, and is a reminder due now? Explain your reasoning.
variants.answer: Use a two-year interval. The last normal screen was 12 months ago, so the next reminder is due in about 12 more months.
variants.rationale: This asymptomatic 46-year-old at average risk is in the 40–74 age group covered by the USPSTF mammography recommendation. Counting two years from the previous routine screen gives the reminder date.
